source_title: Mega Roadshow In Gujarat, Rs 14,000-Crore Projects Launch And Ekta Diwas Visit - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
A roadshow took place in Banaskantha during a two-day official visit to Gujarat, where attendees gathered along the route holding the national flag. Over the course of the visit, national development projects valued at over 14,400 crore rupees are scheduled for inauguration and foundation-stone laying. These initiatives include the launch of an embryo transfer technology laboratory, a bovine breeding and research centre in Bhildi, and metro rail expansion phases for the airport and GIFT City extensions. Furthermore, the twenty-fourth instalment of the PM Kisan scheme, amounting to approximately 19,000 crore rupees, is slated for release. The scheduled itinerary also includes travel to Ekta Nagar to participate in Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations at the Statue of Unity and inaugurate Bharat Parv. Gatherings along the event route displayed placards highlighting rural welfare schemes, pucca housing, and economic initiatives, addressing opposition statements regarding governance and leadership.
